Package org.bsc.langgraph4j

package org.bsc.langgraph4j
The org.bsc.langgraph4j package provides classes and interfaces for building stateful, multi-agent applications with LLMs. It includes core components such as StateGraph and CompiledGraph, which facilitate the creation and management of state graphs.

Key classes and interfaces:

  • StateGraph - Represents a state graph with nodes and edges.
  • CompiledGraph - Represents a compiled state graph ready for execution.

Utility classes:

  • CollectionsUtils - Provides utility methods for creating collections.

Exception classes:

  • GraphStateException - Exception thrown when there is an error related to the state of a graph.
